label: The four layers of a simulator
section: The four layers of a simulator
subgoals: Place scheduling semantics and the value system in the core
Place X-propagation modes and partitioning heuristics in the policy layer
Place seeds, threads and dump scope in parameters, and VPI in hooks

label: Classifying change requests
subgoals: Classify a dump-scope change as Tier 1 configuration
Classify a new X policy or coverage monitor as a Tier 2 plug-in
Classify any change to region order or value semantics as Tier 3

label: Designing seams that keep compiled speed
section: Designing seams that keep compiled speed
subgoals: Call plug-ins per batch or per cycle rather than per event
Pass the operator, operand X bits and context to an X policy
Require determinism and differential evidence before promotion
